findings.title: More than one title element is present.
findings.evidence: About the studio | Duplicate SEO title
findings.fix: Use one title owner; review theme and SEO plugin output.

findings.title: The canonical points somewhere else.
findings.fix: Confirm the canonical destination. On staging, a production canonical may be deliberate.

findings.title: The production page requests no indexing.
findings.fix: Remove an unintended noindex directive before launch.

findings.title: No main H1 heading was found.
findings.fix: Check the page heading and any JavaScript-rendered content.

findings.title: Much less text is available in the fetched HTML.
findings.fix: Check for lost content and JavaScript-only rendering. This is a comparison signal, not a content-quality score.

findings.title: The enquiry form is no longer found in the HTML.
findings.evidence: The original page had email and message fields; the new HTML does not.
findings.fix: Check whether it moved or requires JavaScript. Test saving and email delivery manually.

findings.title: A previous contact link changed or disappeared.
findings.fix: Confirm the correct telephone and email details, including intentional changes.

findings.title: The old URL does not redirect to its mapped destination.
findings.fix: Add a direct permanent redirect from the old route to the mapped destination.

findings.title: Intentional page retirement confirmed.
findings.fix: Keep the removal documented and update internal links.

findings.title: An old page redirects to the homepage.
findings.fix: Map this page to a relevant destination or document its removal.

findings.title: The title changed.
findings.fix: Confirm that this wording change is intentional.

findings.title: The route has a redirect chain.
findings.fix: Redirect directly to the final destination.

limits: Read-only HTTP checks; no forms submitted or emails verified.
JavaScript is not executed by the CLI. HTML-only forms and content may need manual review.
Only fetched internal links and same-origin image URLs are checked.
A clean report is not a ranking, accessibility or delivery guarantee.
